integrity: The proof conditions directly on the sampled minimum, derives an exact tail-mean recurrence, and shows that the three-halves slope forces equal consecutive spacings. The converse and correlation are exact. A finite exact-rational census is supplementary and is not used as the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The rigidity theorem is for sample size two, strict population ordering, and the regression slope three halves.
It does not classify other affine regression slopes or populations with ties.
A general finite-population order-statistic joint law is known; the claim is the inverse equal-spacing characterization derived from the conditional regression.
title: A three-halves minimum-total regression characterizes arithmetic finite populations
